data.title: Dispatch Opens Its Wealth Operations Platform to the Industry With Launch of the Dispatch API
data.description: In New York, Dispatch has introduced the Dispatch API, aiming to provide the wealth industry with their data infrastructure platform for revenue-critical workflows. This new API allows wealthtech firms, fintech providers, and innovative registered investment advisors (RIAs) to integrate Dispatch's proven capabilities into their own products and processes. The initial feature available through the Dispatch API is account opening. This innovation enables companies to embed Dispatch's functionalities directly into their systems, enhancing efficiency and productivity in the wealth management sector.

data.title: Jumio Extends True Reusable Identity to APAC with selfie.DONE™, Powered by Global Identity Graph
data.description: Jumio, a leading provider of AI-powered identity intelligence, has introduced its reusable identity solution, selfie.DONE, in the Asia-Pacific region. This marks a significant milestone in the company's global expansion, following successful launches in Latin America and North America. With selfie.DONE, the conventional practice of initiating each onboarding process with an ID document is no longer obligatory. This innovative approach offers a selfie-first experience to users, enhancing efficiency and user experience.

data.title: NIQ Expands Shopper Intelligence Capabilities in Singapore and Hong Kong Through Enhanced Homescan Coverage
data.description: NielsenIQ, a prominent consumer intelligence firm publicly traded as NIQ, has introduced its upgraded Homescan consumer panels in Singapore and Hong Kong. These enhancements have augmented the categories for monthly analysis by 85% in Singapore and 64% in Hong Kong. This extension provides brands and retailers with a more comprehensive perspective on consumer buying patterns, shopping locations, and influencing factors. This move comes as consumer behavior undergoes significant transformations in the retail sector.

data.title: Shanghai Electric Reports 16.6% Revenue Growth in H1 2026 as New Orders Reach CNY 100.39 Billion
data.description: Shanghai Electric has reported its interim results for the first half of 2026, showcasing an enhanced focus on the rapid implementation of renewable energy and advanced artificial intelligence solutions in European and Middle Eastern regions. The company, listed as SEHK: 02727 and SSE: 601727, is driving significant project advancements in these markets. This strategic move underlines a commitment to sustainable practices and technological innovation to meet the growing energy demands of these areas.

data.title: Corteva Categorically Rejects Unfounded, Unprecedented Allegations by State Attorneys General
